sources.excerpt: ULTRA 47 RAM'S HEAD – Stomp Under Foot Skip to content Search Search Cart PRODUCTS CONTACT FAQ DEALERS ARTISTS ABOUT BLOG Skip to product information Previous Next Close ULTRA 47 RAM'S HEAD® Regular price $249.99 By Stomp Under Foot Quantity SOLD OUT At this point, I thought I had seen it all, but recently I discovered a late 1973/early 1974 pedal that completely blew me away, and I knew I had to make this circuit. Very similar to the 2247, but it utilizes those large capacitors throughout the entire circuit, resulting in a surprisingly massive sound that never gets muddy, it just stays huge. The lower notes are gnarly, wooly, and full of growl, yet retain amazing clarity, while the lead tones are warm, punchy, and incredibly smooth. It remains one of the most impressive Big Muffs I have ever played. Features: True-Bypass NOS Through-Hole Components 9V Battery or 2.1 9V Adapter Only Handmade in the U.S.A.
